announcements.title: Annual sports Day 2026
announcements.content: We are excited to announce our Annual Sports Day on April 25th. All students from Grade 3-12 are expected to participate. Parents are welcome to attend.
announcements.author: By principal Johnson

announcements.title: Parent teacher conference schedula
announcements.content: Parent-Teacher conferences will be held from May 5-7. Please book your slot through the parent portal. Slots are limited and assigned on first-come basis.
announcements.author: By principal Johnson

announcements.title: Library Book Return Reminder
announcements.content: All borrowed library books must be returned by April 30th. Late returns will incur a fine of $2 per day. Please check your student account for outstanding items.
announcements.author: By principal Johnson

announcements.title: Science Fair Registration open
announcements.content: Registration for the annual Science Fair is now open. Students in Grades 6-8 can submit their project proposals by April 20th. Winners receive scholarships.
announcements.author: By principal Johnson
